summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed a routine Form 8-K furnishing its September 2026 monthly investor report under Item 7.01 and announcing a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.076725 per trust certificate, payable October 13, 2026 to holders of record October 12, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, activist, going-private, or restructuring event is disclosed; exhibits are the monthly reporting package and distribution press release. The filing is an ordinary periodic distribution and reporting update for the net-lease trust, with no deal terms, advisors, board recommendation, or regulatory clock to track.
